title: Eleven Winters and One Short Animal
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学、艺术与体育）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学、艺术与体育）　|　核心词汇：fable　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 fable 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1934 my grandmother ① told a fable that no teacher in the school would have written, and she said the telling was the whole of the winter. The ② fable, meaning the tale itself and not the lesson, ran eleven winters and stayed unwritten in the book; a fable, she said, is the only thing in a school that is judged by how long it is left unwritten.

Every ③ fable in that school had the same short animal beside it, and the ④ fable at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A fable, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to write; my grandmother said the writing is the part that fills eleven winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the fable was the whole of the evening, meaning the story and not the tale. The ⑥ fable, meaning the story and not any of that, is the only thing in an evening that everybody waits for and nobody writes; fable, he said, is either something you tell or the only word that means both a tale and a story. He said the story is the part they remember.

By 1941 the ⑦ fable had become a line in a reader, and the reader had become an argument about the short animal. The ⑧ fable of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in January, was one school and eleven winters of writing; fable, she said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to write. She said the writing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ fable I remember is the one written in the reader, which closed in 1945 and is still described as the quietest in the school. A ⑩ fable, my mother said in 1947, is the only one that improves by being written; every fable, she said, is a story that has agreed to look like a tale. She said the story was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 寓言（指学校里每一则旁边的那一则）
B. n. 寓言（指那一则本身，与寓意相对）
C. 固定搭配：tell a fable 讲一则寓言
D. n. 寓言（指留给孩子的那一则）
E. n. 寓言（抽象总称，指一所学校的寓言之事）
F. n. 寓言（指读本上写到、被写下的那一则）
G. n. 故事；传说（指一个夜晚里人人都等却无人写下的那样东西）
H. n. 故事（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人写下的那样东西）

items.q: told a fable that no teacher in the school would have written
The fable, meaning the tale itself and not the lesson
the fable at the far side
the fable was the whole of the evening
the fable had become a line in a reader
The fable of the whole thing
A fable, my mother said in 1947

answers.why: tell a fable 意为“讲一则寓言”，1934 年祖母讲了一则学校里没有一位老师肯写下的寓言。
fable 意为“寓言”，指那一则本身而不是寓意，它经过了十一个冬天而在簿子上没有记号。
fable 意为“寓言”，指学校里每一则旁边的那一则，每一则旁边都有同一只短短的小动物。
fable 意为“寓言”，指留给孩子的那一则，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
fable 意为“故事、传说”，指一个夜晚里人人都等却无人写下的那样东西，叔叔说这个故事就是那个夜晚的全部。
fable 意为“故事”，指人人都等却无人写下的那样东西而不是那一则寓言，是夜晚里人人都等、却无人写下的东西。
fable 意为“寓言”，指读本上写到、被写下的那一则，到 1941 年这一则成了读本里的一行。
fable 意为“寓言”，祖母一月写道，整件事的寓言之事是一所学校和十一个冬天的写下。
fable 意为“寓言”，我记得的是读本上写下的那一则，1945 年结束了，至今仍被说成学校里最安静的一则。
fable 为抽象总称，母亲 1947 年说，一则是唯一会因为被好好写下而变得更好的东西。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。

那则寓言，指的是那一则本身而不是寓意，经过了十一个冬天而在簿子上没有记号。（fable）

叔叔说这个故事就是那个夜晚的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那一则寓言。（fable）
